title: The Silk Road
synopsis: The Han dynasty enjoys a long period of enlightened rule, and the Silk Road is born.

fullText.simplified:
丝绸之路

    刘邦死后，只留下一个儿子。这个不受宠却很幸运的儿子就当上了皇帝，成为了汉文帝。在汉文帝跟他的儿子汉景帝两个人的治理下，汉朝维持了很长一段时间的富裕和安宁。后来，人们把这一段时期称为“文景之治”，用来纪念这两个皇帝。
    此时，汉朝皇帝们最头疼的事是北方匈奴。这个“邻居”脾气不好，常常闹事。汉文帝和汉景帝的处理办法就是派公主去跟匈奴人结婚，以此来维持友好关系。然而，汉朝越是友好，匈奴便越是嚣张。
    到了汉景帝的儿子汉武帝这里情况发生了变化。汉武帝跟他爸爸汉景帝还有祖父汉文帝大不相同，他是个很有魄力的人，特别想找机会好好教训匈奴一番。
    有一天，机会来了。匈奴把邻居大月氏国打败了，汉武帝便想派人去找大月氏国交涉，一起抵抗匈奴。
    这时一个叫张骞的青年出现了。他受汉武帝派遣，连同一百多个手下出使大月氏国。但他真是难得一见的“倒霉蛋”，还没越过边界就被匈奴人抓住了。
    匈奴不让他们离开，一边诱惑他们，一边向他们示威，希望他们不要为汉朝做事了。但张骞什么也不听，宁愿吃不饱、睡不好，也不接受匈奴的好处。
    就这样过了十年，张骞终于抓住了一个机会，连同手下一起跑了。他们穿过沙漠、冰川，走到了现在的中亚草原，总算在那里找到了大月氏人。让人想不到的是，大月氏人已经离开荒凉的沙漠很多年了，他们现在在草原生活得非常快活，无忧无虑，并不想再回去为了一块“破地方”跟匈奴人打得头破血流了。
    失望的张骞只能往回走，而且又不幸被匈奴人捉住了。难道他又要等十年吗？
    幸运的是，张骞这次很快又一次逃了出来，最终回到了长安。就像哥伦布无意中发现新大陆一样，张骞虽然没完成原来的计划，但向汉武帝描绘了他一路上的见闻。他发现远方有个广阔的西域，那里有盛产汗血宝马的大宛国，有对汉朝表示友好的乌孙国，还有很多的沙漠里的绿洲王国。那里有很多新奇、罕见的农作物，比如葡萄、石榴、蚕豆、大蒜，这些都是当时汉朝没有的东西。
    汉武帝听得激动极了，好像全身的血都烧起来一样。他决定继续打匈奴。大月氏虽然不配合，但这次他可以联合对汉朝友好的那个乌孙国啊。
    于是，张骞再次动身去了西域。他这次很顺利就来到了乌孙国。同时，他还去了中亚和西亚，和那里的大夏、大宛、康居等国家建立了外交关系。知道了怎么去西域各国后，许多使者和商人都开始跟汉朝经商，一条空前绝后的“丝绸之路”形成了。
    后来，张骞探索出的丝绸之路慢慢扩大，最后甚至连接到地中海那边的罗马帝国和埃及。汉朝的丝绸、漆器和打井、炼铁技术，顺着这条道路传了出去。而西域的好马、奇异的瓜果蔬菜，甚至更远的罗马帝国的马戏、魔术也顺着这条道路传到了中国，改变了人们的生活。中国人现在吃的很多水果和蔬菜，还是那时候张骞从国外带来的呢！
fullText.traditional:
絲綢之路

    劉邦死後，只留下一個兒子。這個不受寵卻很幸運的兒子就當上了皇帝，成為了漢文帝。在漢文帝跟他的兒子漢景帝兩個人的治理下，漢朝維持了很長一段時間的富裕和安寧。後來，人們把這一段時期稱為“文景之治”，用來紀念這兩個皇帝。
    此時，漢朝皇帝們最頭疼的事是北方匈奴。這個“鄰居”脾氣不好，常常鬧事。漢文帝和漢景帝的處理辦法就是派公主去跟匈奴人結婚，以此來維持友好關係。然而，漢朝越是友好，匈奴便越是囂張。
    到了漢景帝的兒子漢武帝這裡情況發生了變化。漢武帝跟他爸爸漢景帝還有祖父漢文帝大不相同，他是個很有魄力的人，特別想找機會好好教訓匈奴一番。
    有一天，機會來了。匈奴把鄰居大月氏國打敗了，漢武帝便想派人去找大月氏國交涉，一起抵抗匈奴。
    這時一個叫張騫的青年出現了。他受漢武帝派遣，連同一百多個手下出使大月氏國。但他真是難得一見的“倒霉蛋”，還沒越過邊界就被匈奴人抓住了。
    匈奴不讓他們離開，一邊誘惑他們，一邊向他們示威，希望他們不要為漢朝做事了。但張騫什麼也不聽，寧願吃不飽、睡不好，也不接受匈奴的好處。
    就這樣過了十年，張騫終於抓住了一個機會，連同手下一起跑了。他們穿過沙漠、冰川，走到了現在的中亞草原，總算在那裡找到了大月氏人。讓人想不到的是，大月氏人已經離開荒涼的沙漠很多年了，他們現在在草原生活得非常快活，無憂無慮，並不想再回去為了一塊“破地方”跟匈奴人打得頭破血流了。
    失望的張騫只能往回走，而且又不幸被匈奴人捉住了。難道他又要等十年嗎？
    幸運的是，張騫這次很快又一次逃了出來，最終回到了長安。就像哥倫布無意中發現新大陸一樣，張騫雖然沒完成原來的計劃，但向漢武帝描繪了他一路上的見聞。他發現遠方有個廣闊的西域，那裡有盛產汗血寶馬的大宛國，有對漢朝表示友好的烏孫國，還有很多的沙漠裡的綠洲王國。那裡有很多新奇、罕見的農作物，比如葡萄、石榴、蠶豆、大蒜，這些都是當時漢朝沒有的東西。
    漢武帝聽得激動極了，好像全身的血都燒起來一樣。他決定繼續打匈奴。大月氏雖然不配合，但這次他可以聯合對漢朝友好的那個烏孫國啊。
    於是，張騫再次動身去了西域。他這次很順利就來到了烏孫國。同時，他還去了中亞和西亞，和那裡的大夏、大宛、康居等國家建立了外交關係。知道了怎麼去西域各國後，許多使者和商人都開始跟漢朝經商，一條空前絕後的“絲綢之路”形成了。
    後來，張騫探索出的絲綢之路慢慢擴大，最後甚至連接到地中海那邊的羅馬帝國和埃及。漢朝的絲綢、漆器和打井、煉鐵技術，順著這條道路傳了出去。而西域的好馬、奇異的瓜果蔬菜，甚至更遠的羅馬帝國的馬戲、魔術也順著這條道路傳到了中國，改變了人們的生活。中國人現在吃的很多水果和蔬菜，還是那時候張騫從國外帶來的呢！

sentences.simplified: 就像哥伦布无意中发现新大陆一样，张骞虽然没完成原来的计划，
sentences.traditional: 就像哥倫布無意中發現新大陸一樣，張騫雖然沒完成原來的計劃，
sentences.pinyin: jiù xiàng gē lún bù wú yì zhōng fā xiàn xīn dà lù yí yàng zhāng qiān suī rán méi wán chéng yuán lái de jì huà
sentences.english: Fortunately, Zhang Qian escaped quickly this time and finally returned to Chang’an.

sentences.simplified: 但向汉武帝描绘了他一路上的见闻。
sentences.traditional: 但向漢武帝描繪了他一路上的見聞。
sentences.pinyin: dàn xiàng hàn wǔ dì miáo huì le tā yí lù shang de jiàn wén
sentences.english: Just as Columbus discovered the New World by accident, although Zhang Qian did not accomplish his original plans, ..

sentences.simplified: 他发现远方有个广阔的西域，那里有盛产汗血宝马的大宛国，
sentences.traditional: 他發現遠方有個廣闊的西域，那裡有盛產汗血寶馬的大宛國，
sentences.pinyin: tā fā xiàn yuǎn fāng yǒu ge guǎng kuò de xī yù nà lǐ yǒu shèng chǎn hàn xiě bǎo mǎ de dà yuān guó
sentences.english: .. he described to Emperor Wu everything he came across along the way.

sentences.simplified: 有对汉朝表示友好的乌孙国，还有很多的沙漠里的绿洲王国。
sentences.traditional: 有對漢朝表示友好的烏孫國，還有很多的沙漠裡的綠洲王國。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu duì hàn cháo biǎo shì yǒu hǎo de wū sūn guó hái yǒu hěn duō de shā mò lǐ de lǜ zhōu wáng guó
sentences.english: He found the vast Western Regions far away, where there was the Dayuan Kingdom, abundant in Fergana horses.

sentences.simplified: 那里有很多新奇、罕见的农作物，比如葡萄、石榴、蚕豆、大蒜，这些都是当时汉朝没有的东西。
sentences.traditional: 那裡有很多新奇、罕見的農作物，比如葡萄、石榴、蠶豆、大蒜，這些都是當時漢朝沒有的東西。
sentences.pinyin: nà lǐ yǒu hěn duō xīn qí hǎn jiàn de nóng zuò wù bǐ rú pú tao shí liu cán dòu dà suàn zhè xiē dōu shì dāng shí hàn cháo méi yǒu de dōng xi
sentences.english: There was also the Wusun Kingdom, which was friendly to the Han dynasty, as well as many other oasis kingdoms throughout the desert.
There were many new and rare crops, such as grapes, pomegranate, fava beans, and garlic, which the Han dynasty did not have at the time.

sentences.simplified: 汉武帝听得激动极了，好像全身的血都烧起来一样。他决定继续打匈奴。
sentences.traditional: 漢武帝聽得激動極了，好像全身的血都燒起來一樣。他決定繼續打匈奴。
sentences.pinyin: hàn wǔ dì tīng de jī dòng jí le hǎo xiàng quán shēn de xiě dōu shāo qǐ lái yí yàng tā jué dìng jì xù dǎ xiōng nú

sentences.simplified: 大月氏虽然不配合，但这次他可以联合对汉朝友好的那个乌孙国啊。
sentences.traditional: 大月氏雖然不配合，但這次他可以聯合對漢朝友好的那個烏孫國啊。
sentences.pinyin: dà yuè zhī suī rán bú pèi hé dàn zhè cì tā kě yǐ lián hé duì hàn cháo yǒu hǎo de nà ge wū sūn guó a
sentences.english: Emperor Wu was very excited to hear this. It stirred his blood, and he decided to continue on and fight the Xiongnu.
Although Greater Yuezhi did not cooperate, he could join forces with the Wusun Kingdom which was friendly with the Han dynasty.

sentences.simplified: 于是，张骞再次动身去了西域。他这次很顺利就来到了乌孙国。
sentences.traditional: 於是，張騫再次動身去了西域。他這次很順利就來到了烏孫國。
sentences.pinyin: yú shì zhāng qiān zài cì dòng shēn qù le xī yù tā zhè cì hěn shùn lì jiù lái dào le wū sūn guó

sentences.simplified: 同时，他还去了中亚和西亚，
sentences.traditional: 同時，他還去了中亞和西亞，
sentences.pinyin: tóng shí tā hái qù le zhōng yà hé xī yà
sentences.english: Thereupon, Zhang Qian set out once again for the Western Regions. This time he made it to the Wusun kingdom very smoothly.

sentences.simplified: 和那里的大夏、大宛、康居等国家建立了外交关系。
sentences.traditional: 和那裡的大夏、大宛、康居等國家建立了外交關係。
sentences.pinyin: hé nà lǐ de dà xià dà yuān kāng jū děng guó jiā jiàn lì le wài jiāo guān xi
sentences.english: At the same time, he also went to Central and Western Asia.

sentences.simplified: 知道了怎么去西域各国后，
sentences.traditional: 知道了怎麼去西域各國後，
sentences.pinyin: zhī dào le zěn me qù xī yù gè guó hòu
sentences.english: He established diplomatic relations with the Daxia, Dayuan, Kangju, and other kingdoms there.

sentences.simplified: 许多使者和商人都开始跟汉朝经商，
sentences.traditional: 許多使者和商人都開始跟漢朝經商，
sentences.pinyin: xǔ duō shǐ zhě hé shāng rén dōu kāi shǐ gēn hàn cháo jīng shāng
sentences.english: Now that people knew how to get to various kingdoms in the Western Regions, ..

sentences.simplified: 一条空前绝后的“丝绸之路”形成了。
sentences.traditional: 一條空前絕後的“絲綢之路”形成了。
sentences.pinyin: yì tiáo kōng qián jué hòu de sī chóu zhī lù xíng chéng le
sentences.english: .. many envoys and merchants began to do business with the Han dynasty.
The unprecedented and unmatched “Silk Road” was formed.

sentences.simplified: 后来，张骞探索出的丝绸之路慢慢扩大，
sentences.traditional: 後來，張騫探索出的絲綢之路慢慢擴大，
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái zhāng qiān tàn suǒ chū de sī chóu zhī lù màn man kuò dà

sentences.simplified: 最后甚至连接到地中海那边的罗马帝国和埃及。
sentences.traditional: 最後甚至連接到地中海那邊的羅馬帝國和埃及。
sentences.pinyin: zuì hòu shèn zhì lián jiē dào dì zhōng hǎi nà bian de luó mǎ dì guó hé āi jí
sentences.english: Later on, the Silk Road began to slowly expand as a result of Zhang Qian’s explorations.

sentences.simplified: 汉朝的丝绸、漆器和打井、炼铁技术，顺着这条道路传了出去。
sentences.traditional: 漢朝的絲綢、漆器和打井、煉鐵技術，順著這條道路傳了出去。
sentences.pinyin: hàn cháo de sī chóu qī qì hé dǎ jǐng liàn tiě jì shù shùn zhe zhè tiáo dào lù chuán le chū qù
sentences.english: Finally, it even connected to the Roman Empire and Egyptian Empire by the Mediterranean Sea.

sentences.simplified: 而西域的好马、奇异的瓜果蔬菜，
sentences.traditional: 而西域的好馬、奇異的瓜果蔬菜，
sentences.pinyin: ér xī yù de hǎo mǎ qí yì de guā guǒ shū cài
sentences.english: The silk and lacquerware, along with well-drilling and iron-making techniques from the Han dynasty, were all spread along this road.

sentences.simplified: 甚至更远的罗马帝国的马戏、魔术
sentences.traditional: 甚至更遠的羅馬帝國的馬戲、魔術
sentences.pinyin: shèn zhì gèng yuǎn de luó mǎ dì guó de mǎ xì mó shù
sentences.english: And the good horses, exotic fruits and vegetables from the Western Regions, ..

sentences.simplified: 也顺着这条道路传到了中国，改变了人们的生活。
sentences.traditional: 也順著這條道路傳到了中國，改變了人們的生活。
sentences.pinyin: yě shùn zhe zhè tiáo dào lù chuán dào le zhōng guó gǎi biàn le rén men de shēng huó
sentences.english: .. and even circuses and magic from the Roman Empire, which was even further away, ..

sentences.simplified: 中国人现在吃的很多水果和蔬菜，还是那时候张骞从国外带来的呢！
sentences.traditional: 中國人現在吃的很多水果和蔬菜，還是那時候張騫從國外帶來的呢！
sentences.pinyin: zhōng guó rén xiàn zài chī de hěn duō shuǐ guǒ hé shū cài hái shi nà shí hou zhāng qiān cóng guó wài dài lái de ne
sentences.english: .. were all spread to China along this road, changing people’s lives.

sentence_translations: The Silk Road
After Liu Bang died, he left behind only one son.
This son, who was not favored but was very lucky, became the emperor, Emperor Wen of Han.
Under the rule of Emperor Wen and his son, Emperor Jing of Han, the Han dynasty maintained a long period of prosperity and peace.
Later, to commemorate these two emperors, people called this period “the Rule of Wen and Jing”.
At that time, the biggest headache for the Han dynasty emperors was the Xiongnu in the north.
This “neighbor” was ill-tempered and often stirred up trouble.
Emperor Wen and Emperor Jing dealt with this by sending princesses to marry the Xiongnu as a way to maintain friendly relations.
Yet, the more friendly the Han dynasty was, the more aggressive the Xiongnu became.
This situation changed with Emperor Jing’s son, Emperor Wu of Han.
Emperor Wu was not like his father, Emperor Jing, or his grandfather, Emperor Wen.
He was a very resolute man who was very keen to find an opportunity to teach the Xiongnu a good lesson.
One day, the opportunity came.
When the Xiongnu defeated its neighbor, the Greater Yuezhi, ..
.. Emperor Wu wanted to send someone to negotiate with the Greater Yuezhi and resist the Xiongnu together.
At this time, a young man named Zhang Qian appeared.
Emperor Wu sent him on a diplomatic mission to the Greater Yuezhi along with more than 100 men.
But, he was really unfortunate as he was caught by the Xiongnu before he crossed the border.
The Xiongnu did not let them leave, luring them while also asserting their power, ..
.. hoping that they would not work for the Han dynasty anymore.
But, Zhang Qian did not listen. He would rather not eat well nor sleep well than accept any benefits from the Xiongnu.
After 10 years passed like this, Zhang Qian finally seized an opportunity and escaped with his men.
They traveled through deserts and glaciers and walked to what is now the Central Asian Steppe, where they finally found the Greater Yuezhi.
Unexpectedly, the Greater Yuezhi had already left the barren deserts many years ago.
Their current life in the grasslands was very happy and carefree.
They did not wish to shed blood fighting with the Xiongnu over this “wretched place”.
The disappointed Zhang Qian could only turn around, and he was unfortunately caught by the Xiongnu once again.
Was he really going to have to wait another 10 years?
Fortunately, Zhang Qian escaped quickly this time and finally returned to Chang’an.
Just as Columbus discovered the New World by accident, although Zhang Qian did not accomplish his original plans, ..
.. he described to Emperor Wu everything he came across along the way.
He found the vast Western Regions far away, where there was the Dayuan Kingdom, abundant in Fergana horses.
There was also the Wusun Kingdom, which was friendly to the Han dynasty, as well as many other oasis kingdoms throughout the desert.
There were many new and rare crops, such as grapes, pomegranate, fava beans, and garlic, which the Han dynasty did not have at the time.
Emperor Wu was very excited to hear this. It stirred his blood, and he decided to continue on and fight the Xiongnu.
Although Greater Yuezhi did not cooperate, he could join forces with the Wusun Kingdom which was friendly with the Han dynasty.
Thereupon, Zhang Qian set out once again for the Western Regions. This time he made it to the Wusun kingdom very smoothly.
At the same time, he also went to Central and Western Asia.
He established diplomatic relations with the Daxia, Dayuan, Kangju, and other kingdoms there.
Now that people knew how to get to various kingdoms in the Western Regions, ..
.. many envoys and merchants began to do business with the Han dynasty.
The unprecedented and unmatched “Silk Road” was formed.
Later on, the Silk Road began to slowly expand as a result of Zhang Qian’s explorations.
Finally, it even connected to the Roman Empire and Egyptian Empire by the Mediterranean Sea.
The silk and lacquerware, along with well-drilling and iron-making techniques from the Han dynasty, were all spread along this road.
And the good horses, exotic fruits and vegetables from the Western Regions, ..
.. and even circuses and magic from the Roman Empire, which was even further away, ..
.. were all spread to China along this road, changing people’s lives.
Many of the fruits and vegetables that Chinese people eat now were brought over from overseas by Zhang Qian during that time!
